seo.title: iWay Tourism — Premier Travel & Tour Agency in Marthandam & Trivandrum
seo.description: Book local tours across Kanyakumari and Trivandrum, rent Innova and Tempo Traveller fleets, or explore international packages to Singapore, Bali, Dubai, and more — all from Marthandam.

hero.heading: Your Gateway to the World from the Deep South of India
hero.subheading: Curated local tours across Kanyakumari and Trivandrum. Reliable fleet rentals. International holiday packages with visa assistance and flights from Trivandrum Airport.
hero.imageAlt: Sunrise over the Triveni Sangam at Kanyakumari with the Vivekananda Rock Memorial silhouetted against the horizon

trustBadges.label: Based in Marthandam, Serving Kanyakumari & Trivandrum
Dedicated Trip Coordinator for Every Booking

localToursPreview.heading: Explore the Deep South
localToursPreview.subheading: From the heritage temples of Trivandrum to the hidden beaches south of Kanyakumari — curated circuits designed by locals who know every back road.

featured.title: Trivandrum to Kanyakumari — 3-Day Coastal Circuit
featured.tagline: 90 km of heritage palaces, waterfalls, and the southernmost tip of India.
featured.imageAlt: Padmanabhapuram Palace wooden facade framed by tropical greenery

featured.title: Kanyakumari Sightseeing
featured.tagline: Vivekananda Rock, Thiruvalluvar Statue, Kumari Amman Temple, and the Triveni Sangam.
featured.imageAlt: Ferry approaching Vivekananda Rock Memorial with waves crashing against the rocky base

featured.title: Hidden Gems of the Deep South
featured.tagline: Vattakottai Fort, Mathur Aqueduct, Sothavilai Beach — places most tourists never find.
featured.imageAlt: Panoramic view of Mathur Aqueduct stretching across a lush green valley in Kanyakumari district

internationalToursPreview.heading: International Holiday Packages from Trivandrum
internationalToursPreview.subheading: Complete packages with flights from TRV, visa processing, hotel bookings, and a dedicated iWay coordinator — no middlemen, no hidden costs.

featured.title: Singapore & Malaysia Combo
featured.tagline: Urban skylines, highland retreats, and island thrills across two nations.
featured.imageAlt: Marina Bay Sands and the Supertree Grove illuminated at night in Singapore

featured.title: Bali Honeymoon Escapes
featured.tagline: Cliffside sunsets, terraced rice fields, and private pool villas in paradise.
featured.imageAlt: Infinity pool overlooking the Tegallalang rice terraces in Ubud, Bali

featured.title: Vietnam Budget Adventures
featured.tagline: Ha Long Bay cruises, Hanoi street food, and Sapa trekking from ₹45,000.
featured.imageAlt: Traditional wooden junk boat sailing through emerald waters among Ha Long Bay limestone karsts

featured.title: Dubai Luxury & Shopping
featured.tagline: Desert safaris, Marina cruises, and world-class shopping in the city of gold.
featured.imageAlt: Dubai skyline at sunset with the Burj Khalifa towering above surrounding skyscrapers

fleetPreview.heading: Reliable Fleet for Every Group Size
fleetPreview.subheading: Airport pickups from Trivandrum, full-day local sightseeing, or multi-day outstation trips — our maintained fleet is available across Kanyakumari and Trivandrum districts.
